name: Beijing
description: Political and administrative center of the Belt and Road Initiative. Home to the National Development and Reform Commission that coordinates BRI strategy.

name: Almaty
description: Kazakhstan's largest city and BRI Central Asia transit hub. Gateway to the New Eurasian Land Bridge and key Silk Road Economic Belt node.

name: Nairobi
description: East Africa's largest city and BRI infrastructure hub. Chinese-funded Standard Gauge Railway connects Nairobi to Mombasa, with extensions planned.

name: Moscow
description: Russia's capital and key BRI transit hub along the Trans-Siberian corridor. Hosts Eurasian Economic Union coordination with BRI.

name: Dubai
description: UAE's financial capital and critical BRI logistics hub connecting Asia to Africa and Europe. JAFZA hosts 350+ Chinese companies.

name: Islamabad
description: Pakistan's capital and CPEC coordination center. CPEC represents Pakistan's largest-ever foreign investment at $62 billion.

name: Addis Ababa
description: Africa Union HQ and major BRI partner city. Chinese-funded Addis Ababa-Djibouti Railway connects Ethiopia to the sea.

name: Tehran
description: Iran's capital and strategic BRI transit hub. China-Iran 25-year cooperation agreement includes $400B investment in transport and energy.

name: Dhaka
description: Bangladesh's capital and BCIM Economic Corridor participant. China is Bangladesh's largest trading partner with significant BRI infrastructure investments.

name: Dushanbe
description: Tajikistan's capital with significant Chinese investment in road and energy infrastructure. Key transit link in BRI Central Asian network.
